name: Blood & Honour
description: Blood & Honour is a neo-Nazi music promotion network and white nationalist political organization founded in the United Kingdom in 1987 by Skrewdriver frontman Ian Stuart Donaldson and Nicky Crane. Launched as a breakaway from the National Front's White Noise Club, it promotes white power music, publishes Blood & Honour magazine, and operates an international network with chapters in multiple countries including the United States. It is affiliated with Combat 18 and banned in several countries including Germany, Spain, Russia, and Canada.
